title: Gluten-Free Japanese-Style Tofu Ramen
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make gluten-free Japanese-inspired ramen dish featuring pan-seared tofu and savory broth.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu cubes and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Add 2 tablespoons of shoyu and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
To assemble the ramen, place noodles in a bowl, then add the pan-seared tofu, and pour the hot shoyu broth over the top.
Garnish with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
